operations.title: The class of alpha Omega is the cohomology-representative anomaly
operations.statement: A graded S induces H^n(H)->H^n(G) iff all target n-cocycles annihilate Omega_(n+1) and every tau_n(alpha)=[alpha Omega_n] vanishes. The identity S^*(d alpha)=d(S^*alpha)+alpha Omega makes tau the exact representative-independence obstruction.

operations.title: Exact-cocycle pullback detects the anomaly class
operations.procedure: Use the Ledger 1324 complex where target [1 0]=d_H(1) and its pullback is the nonzero source class 1.
operations.outcome: tau_1(1)=1, exactly detecting failure of representative-independent cohomological pullback.
operations.falsifier: Any nonzero tau falsifies the claimed cohomology map even when selected cocycles separately descend.
